references.text: The Lord will again rejoice over you and do you good, just as he rejoiced over your fathers - this verse shows the opposite side of God's relationship with his people, where he delights in blessing them.
The Lord your God is with you, a mighty one who saves. He will rejoice over you with gladness - parallel to God's delight in doing good toward his people.
Ezekiel prophesies that the people will be uprooted from the land as punishment for disobedience, reflecting the warning in Deuteronomy.
The warning about being scattered among the nations and uprooted from the land, parallel to the punishment described here.
Joshua warns that the Lord will bring disaster upon them and wipe them out from the land if they break the covenant.
Proverbs confirms that the Lord has created everything for his purpose, even the wicked person for the day of disaster.
